# [Few-Shot Examples](https://stablekernel.github.io/SHRINE/patterns/few-shot-examples/)

Guide output format and style with concrete examples.

Source: `docs/src/content/docs/patterns/few-shot-examples.md` (sha256 `339c1416b467457662f143fe10d504d5fda80b9e6dea2d92873c086980ab70e6`)

- Pattern ([#the-pattern](https://stablekernel.github.io/SHRINE/patterns/few-shot-examples/#the-pattern)):
  - Include 2-5 examples of the input/output format you want before asking for the actual task. The model learns the pattern from examples.
- Use when ([#when-to-use](https://stablekernel.github.io/SHRINE/patterns/few-shot-examples/#when-to-use)):
  - Specific output formats (JSON, markdown structures)
  - Consistent style or tone
  - Domain-specific conventions
  - When verbal descriptions of format are ambiguous
- Not when ([#when-not-to-use](https://stablekernel.github.io/SHRINE/patterns/few-shot-examples/#when-not-to-use)):
  - The format is fully specified by a schema; use [Structured Output](https://stablekernel.github.io/SHRINE/patterns/structured-output/)
  - Reasoning models on tasks they handle zero-shot; try without examples first ([OpenAI](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/reasoning-best-practices))
  - You have only one example and it is an edge case
- Anti-patterns ([#anti-patterns](https://stablekernel.github.io/SHRINE/patterns/few-shot-examples/#anti-patterns)):
  - Too many examples (diminishing returns, context waste)
  - Examples that contradict each other
  - Examples that are too similar (model over-fits to specifics)
